hints.title: Candidate Divisor Verification
hints.text: Instead of finding all subsequences, iterate over each possible common factor up to the maximum element.

hints.title: Multiple Accumulation
hints.text: A candidate divisor g is achievable if and only if the greatest common divisor of all multiples of g present in the array equals g.

hints.title: Early Exit on Exact Match
hints.text: Compute running greatest common divisor across present multiples; if it reduces to g, increment the valid count.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: M is the maximum value in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^n subsequences is exponential and completely impractical.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Harmonic series traversal across multiples bounded by M runs in O(M log M) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks whether the gcd of all present multiples of g equals g rather than forming subsets.
